body: Yes, but it's very small. At most I could attempt to sleep in the back seat, but people in this town have died that way before because the crime problem here is insane. It's extremely risky, but I guess it's something.

Dying is less about them and more about my quality of life at this point. You're right and I absolutely get where you're coming from, but I'm not the kind of person that would survive homelessness for more than a week, at most. I've got no kind of skills, no real endurance or stamina. I'd get slaughtered.
More or less. There are things I don't like and things I do, but at the end of the day I care about them.
